newsitem.title: USA: Forest Oil enters into new credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Forest Oil enters into new credit facility.

text.p: Forest Oil Corp said Friday it entered into a new bank credit facility, with Chase Manhattan Bank as agent.
The new facility increases existing credit availability from $40 million to $60 million and decreases interest rate spreads by about 50 basis points, Forest Oil said.

As a further reflection of the company's improved financial condition, Forest Oil said the new facility also reduces other credit related costs and relaxes restrictions on investments, liens, dividends and other debt.
The maturity date for the new facility is January 31, 2000, Forest Oil said.
The company said it intends to use the credit facility primarily to enhance liquidity available for funding potential acquisitions and other general corporate purposes.
